_parameters.min_observations: Per dataset: how many (before, after) step pairs an action category needs before any template is run on it.
_parameters.min_rule_observations: Per dataset: how many observations a guarded rule (correlation, path_key, value_to_key, key_containment) needs, counting only steps where its guard applies, before it is reported.
_parameters.min_observations_for_promotion: Per dataset: how many observations a candidate needs to be promotable. A dataset below this marks the candidate INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
_parameters.promotion_threshold: Per-dataset support (held / observations) a candidate needs in EVERY dataset to be promoted. In (0, 1].
_parameters.change_count_min_share: change_count template: the most common DeepDiff change count k is only proposed if it covers at least this share of the steps. In (0, 1].
_parameters.max_examples: How many hold / fail examples are kept per finding, and how many counter-examples are listed per line of the report.
_parameters.sweep_start: threshold_sweep.py: first promotion threshold to try.
_parameters.sweep_end: threshold_sweep.py: last promotion threshold to try (inclusive).
_parameters.dashboard_near_margin: Dashboard and report: a per-dataset support that is below promotion_threshold by no more than this margin is shown as 'close' (amber). In (0, 1].
